headline: Calmer days 14–17 Nov; TMD expects heavy rain in the South again 18–22 Nov.

warnings.title: Flood & landslide alert, 15 provinces incl. Krabi, 18–22 Nov
warnings.detail: DDPM/TMD: stronger monsoon, heavy rain; avoid hillsides and streams in downpours, waves above 2 m in storms.

ferries.detail: No current suspension found; boats can stop in high waves, so confirm with the operator or hotel the day before.

news.title: TMD advisory No. 8: heavy rain in the lower South
news.detail: Krabi still on the heavy-rain list through 22 Nov; flash flood risk near hills and streams.

news.title: TMD advisory No. 6: heavy rain in the South 18–22 Nov
news.detail: Krabi on the heavy-rain list from today; stay off boats in storms and confirm the 23 Nov ferry the day before.

news.title: Krabi and Phuket on flood/landslide alert 18–22 Nov
news.detail: Keep the last days calm; confirm the 23 Nov ferry with the hotel the day before.

news.title: Krabi back on heavy-rain list today; wetter 18–20 Nov
news.detail: Showers today; monsoon strengthens 18–20 Nov with flash flood risk. Plan calm activities those days.

news.title: TMD: five days of heavy southern rain 18–22 Nov
news.detail: Do boat trips before the 18th; check ferries the day before any crossing.

sourceTitle: Nation Thailand: heavy rain in the South 7–9 Nov
